revision: Independent corner supports and accessible top-edge probes
method: The current routed PCB is authoritative. Its translated PD header, input bulk, local U3 feedback and seven top-edge contacts were reviewed together with the retained power stages.

fresh_routing_workflow.scope: Generate current placement, create a new routing session and finish that session. Apply the back-silkscreen artwork after final routing and before checks/export. This is not a byte-identical replay of the checked routed PCB. Native DRC/parity, power geometry and populated assembly checks are required before replacing the current source.

development_history.note: This hash identifies the earlier development input in Git history only. Superseded local PCB snapshots and one-time migration scripts were removed; neither is a dependency of the current design.

route_polylines_scope: Retained coordinates of the reviewed local rerouting only; not a complete board router session or a script to apply to the current PCB.
support_fit_boundary: Three PD mounts use 3.2mm holes; four corner supports use the exact HC11 drawing nominal 3.0mm holes. The 11mm HC11 does not clear the downward-facing assembly above a flat floor.
